text:
sam: Quick thread: search is returning stale pages after the docs import and some images are 403 when embedded in our onboarding email.

sam: affected examples:
- /guides/getting-started/setup -> search returns old slug
- /docs/getting-started/setup-diagram.svg -> 403 when Referer header set
- /kb/ops/release-playbook -> missing anchor `#postdeploy-checks` (404)

sam: repro (image):
```
curl -I -e https://app.redwood.ai https://docs.redwood.ai/docs/getting-started/setup-diagram.svg
# returns 403
```

kevin: that referrer 403 looks like our CDN referrer policy change. I'll revert rule for images used in emails and run a cache purge. INFRA-912 created.

lina: missing anchors mostly in localized fr/ copies. I can sweep locale frontmatter and check if anchors got stripped. If owners are missing, I'll assign.

ryan: I'll add `owner: "@ryan"` to the guides that lost ownership and open redirects for renamed slugs. PR: docs/guides/#311

docs-bot: DocSweep result: 9 issues found, details uploaded: docsweep-1972501200.json

sam: plan: do temporary 302 redirects for the changed slugs until we confirm content parity, then flip to 301. Also need search reindex once redirects are in place.

kevin: agreed. I'll gate the CDN purge until PRs merge. After that I'll trigger reindex (search-job/trigger 197).

lina: tagging @ryan @kevin. i'll start a small PR to add missing anchors for fr pages and add owners. Link the PRs in ENG-TRACK-3221.

sam: thanks. I'll track in the onboarding ticket and post a short note to #product if onboarding email links change.

ryan: PR opened: docs/guides/#311. Added owners and 302 redirect rules. please review.

kevin: INFRA-912 PR submitted with rollback steps and cache timeline. Will comment on ENG-TRACK-3221 when purge scheduled.

sam: marking thread active until search reindex shows green. Ping here for any deploy blocks. :thumbsup:
